logline: Pip won't share her bouncy ball and Biscuit is sad, so Pip has an idea: take turns. They play catch and every catch plays a note.

publish.title: Pip Won't Share Her Ball! 🔴🐶 Taking Turns for Kids #forkids
publish.description:
Pip has a bouncy red ball, and Biscuit wants to play too! "No! It's mine!" Uh-oh... Biscuit is sad. Can Pip find a way to share? A little story about taking turns for toddlers and preschoolers.

New Pip & Biscuit cartoons every week.

#forkids #kidscartoon #shorts #sharing #takingturns #preschool
